basic.name: Sawblade Tuning
basic.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Himeko's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Molten Detonation
skill.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Himeko's ATK to a single enemy and Fire DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Himeko's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

ultimate.name: Heavenly Flare
ultimate.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Himeko's ATK to all enemies. Himeko regenerates 5 extra Energy for each enemy defeated.

technique.name: Incomplete Combustion
technique.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for 15 second(s). After entering battle with enemies in the Special Dimension, there is a 100% base chance to increase Fire DMG taken by enemies by 10% for 2 turn(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

talent.name: Victory Rush
talent.description_template: When an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, Himeko gains 1 point of Charge (max 3 points). If Himeko is fully Charged when an ally performs an attack, Himeko immediately performs 1 Follow-Up ATK and deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of her ATK to all enemies, consuming all Charge points. At the start of the battle, Himeko gains 1 point of Charge.

2.name: Starfire
2.description: After using an attack, there is a 50% base chance to inflict Burn on enemies for 2 turn(s).

4.name: Magma
4.description: Skill deals 20% more DMG to enemies currently afflicted with Burn.

6.name: Benchmark
6.description: When current HP percentage is 80% or higher, CRIT Rate increases by 15%.

eidolons.name: Childhood
eidolons.description: After "Victory Rush" is triggered, Himeko's SPD increases by 20% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Convergence
eidolons.description: Deals 15% more DMG to enemies whose HP percentage is 50% or less.

eidolons.name: Poised
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Dedication
eidolons.description: When Himeko's Skill inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, she gains 1 extra point(s) of Charge.

eidolons.name: Aspiration
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Trailblaze!
eidolons.description: Ultimate deals DMG 2 extra times, each of which deals Fire DMG equal to 40% of the original DMG to a random enemy.
